I'm sorry to hear your order arrived damaged. Here's what to do:
Document the Damage:
Take photos of the damaged packaging itself
Unbox the item and inspect it thoroughly
Take clear photos of the entire product and close-ups of any affected areas (punctures, indentations, etc.)
Include a common object near the damage to show scale
Photograph the law tag showing the barcode (both front and back if available)
Note the unboxing date
Contact Our Support Team:
Once you've documented everything, email the photos and a description to our support team along with your order details, email, and current shipping address. The team will review your documentation and guide you through the next steps — which may include a replacement.
